item.title: Prism 1.1.1
item.description:
Prism 1.1.1 is faster, steadier and easier to read at a glance.

  • Each step splits about 15% faster, and Prism wakes far less often while paused.
  • Turning Prism off, or switching the source or output, no longer freezes the panel.
  • Turning Prism back on is instant: the model stays loaded.
  • If the GPU reports errors, Prism skips that moment instead of quitting, and stops with a message if it keeps happening.
  • The menu bar prism fills in while Prism is splitting.
  • The source menu ticks the app you're listening to, and covers fade in when the song changes.
  • If Prism isn't allowed to control Spotify or Music, the panel says so and opens the right setting.
  • The Latency menu now gives the real delays: about 3, 5 or 8 seconds.
  • Space plays and pauses, and VoiceOver can read and adjust every stem.
  • Only one copy of Prism runs at a time.

macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon. Notarized by Apple.

item.title: Prism 1.1
item.description:
Prism now keeps itself up to date.

  • Check for Updates: Prism checks once a day, or choose Check for Updates… in the Prism menu or the ••• menu.
  • Report a Problem… in the ••• menu opens a GitHub issue with your Mac's details filled in.
  • The level meters in the menu bar panel keep moving after you close the main window.
  • Setup checks there's enough free space before downloading, and a damaged model file is downloaded again.
  • Prism now installs only on Macs with Apple silicon.

macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon. Notarized by Apple.
